title: test: Keycloak OIDC and Thunderbird JMAP integration tests
description:
Two deferred integration tests (stoa-da550e08 and stoa-14b79078) cover the full auth and JMAP client interop surface that cannot be tested in unit tests:

1. Keycloak OIDC (3axq): spin up a Keycloak instance via docker-compose, configure a realm and client for stoa-reader/stoa-mail, verify token issuance and OIDC authentication through the auth crate end-to-end. This is the only integration path for the OIDC code.

2. Thunderbird JMAP folder subscription (dd40): verify that Thunderbird can connect to stoa-mail via JMAP, see groups as folders (Mailbox/get), subscribe/unsubscribe (Mailbox/set), and fetch articles. This tests the full JMAP client interop path including capability negotiation.

What needs to be done:
1. Add a docker-compose.keycloak.yml with a pre-configured realm export.
2. Add an integration test (integration-tests/tests/oidc_keycloak.rs) that authenticates through Keycloak and verifies protected NNTP/JMAP endpoints accept the token.
3. Add a Thunderbird automation script (headless profile) that connects to stoa-mail, lists folders, subscribes to one, and fetches an article.
4. Document the test setup in docs/testing.md.

Adopts deferred issues: stoa-da550e08, stoa-14b79078.
